title: Canonicalize cutover home paths before deriving the Windows mutex
outcome: Make supported apply, recovery and rollback commands targeting the same store home share one named Windows mutex regardless of a trailing directory separator.
acceptance: Home paths with and without a trailing separator produce the same mutex identity for apply and journal-based recovery or rollback.
Path-root semantics remain valid and distinct store homes do not share a mutex.
Regression coverage proves competing supported commands for equivalent home spellings serialize or refuse consistently.
